resources.string: Connect your ChatGPT account and grant plan usage before choosing a model. This installation keeps its issued registration for subsequent sign-ins. No API key is required.
Choose from models discovered through your authorized account. Available models depend on your account and OpenAI service availability. Selecting a model does not send a voice request.
Open ChatGPT usage settings in your browser to review your plan and service limits.

Clear this app’s local credentials and selected model, and attempt remote token revocation. The installation’s issued registration is retained for future sign-in. If revocation cannot be confirmed, disconnect the app in ChatGPT settings.

Open Android permission settings to allow answers over other apps. An enabled accessibility service can also show answer overlays. Without either permission, answers remain visible in the voice panel.

Open Android’s assistant settings to select Aho! GPT where supported. The system assistant shortcut opens its voice panel. TV remote shortcuts require your separate button mapper; this app does not intercept remote keys.

Rescan visible installed apps for accessible exported intent declarations. The local catalog is searched during requests; selected results may be sent to OpenAI. A discovered declaration does not guarantee that Android will permit its execution or that an action will complete.
Tap account or model to finish setup in settings.
Tap the microphone to speak. Tap a status row for settings.

Text-to-speech reads answers aloud using the default Android engine. Use the gear to choose a language or an installed voice, preview it, or open Android TTS settings. Turning TTS off keeps answers visible and stops automatic follow-up listening. The switch is unavailable when no ready voices are reported or an installed Google app is disabled. Voice availability depends on the device; a voice may use its provider’s network service.

Speech-to-text recognizes your spoken requests using Android’s speech provider, preferring on-device recognition. Use the gear to select a language, test recognition, or open Android speech settings. Tests stay on this device and never trigger OpenAI requests or tools. Turning STT off prevents listening. The switch is unavailable when no recognizer is installed or an installed Google app is disabled. Recognition may use the provider’s network service.
No ready text-to-speech voices. Use the gear to open Android settings.
The Google app is disabled. Enable it in Android app settings to use speech.
Voice playback is off. The answer remains visible; enable TTS in Languages to hear answers.
Speech recognition is off. Enable STT in Languages to speak a request.
The selected voice or its language data is unavailable. Choose a ready voice in Languages or check Android TTS settings.
Choose the default voice for a language or select an installed voice. Changing the voice does not translate answer text.
Hello! This is the Aho! GPT voice test.
Voice test failed. Check Android TTS settings.
Recognition test ended. Tap Test to try again.
Credits: Android provides the native interface, speech recognition and text-to-speech. OpenAI provides model inference. Architecture and settings style follow ViBRo Navigator.

Spoken requests, temporary conversation context and selected tool results are sent to OpenAI. Conversations stay in memory and are cleared after expiry or when the voice panel closes. There is no saved chat history. Speech providers may process audio or playback text using their network services.\n\nThe installed-app catalog stays local until selected search results are returned to the model. Optional accessibility tools can send visible screen content during your requests; password fields are excluded. Tokens and screen contents are never written to app logs. Credentials are protected in Android storage and excluded from backups. OpenAI and speech-provider data policies also apply.

Aho! GPT requires a supported OpenAI account, an available model and Android speech providers. Account access, model availability and service limits depend on OpenAI. Device actions depend on Android permissions and the target app; a dispatched action does not prove task completion. Review requested actions and close the voice panel to cancel pending work. Actions already dispatched cannot be undone by cancellation. This app is not an official OpenAI product.

plurals.item: Provider reports %1$d available language. Tap the language above to choose it. Device language may require additional voice data.
Provider reports %1$d available languages. Tap the language above to choose one. Device language may require additional voice data.

resources.string: The provider reports no ready languages for this request. Check the device’s speech settings or install language data.
Language support was not reported. The picker lists device locales; recognition or playback support must be checked with the installed provider.
Speech recognition is not supported or its language data is unavailable for %1$s. Choose another STT language in About & settings or install the language in the device’s speech settings.
The device’s text-to-speech engine is unavailable. The answer remains visible.
Voice data is missing for %1$s. Install it in the device’s text-to-speech settings or choose another TTS language. The answer remains visible.
The text-to-speech engine does not support %1$s. Choose another TTS language in About & settings. The answer remains visible.
Voice playback failed for %1$s. Check the device’s text-to-speech settings. The answer remains visible.
A lightweight voice assistant for Android, Android TV and Wear OS. Speak a request, hear an answer, and continue with a brief spoken follow-up. No chat screen or saved conversation history.
Speak again within eight seconds to continue.
Session ended. Tap the microphone for a new request.
The request completed without a spoken answer.
Install or enable a system speech recognition service on this device.
System speech recognition error %1$d. Tap the microphone to retry.
Open Aho! GPT, tap the app logo or account status for About & settings, continue with ChatGPT, then choose a model.
Connect your ChatGPT plan. If the embedded page refuses sign-in, use Open in browser.
Sign-in received. Return to Aho! GPT.
A browser on this device is required for sign-in. Wear OS does not support WebView. Install a compatible watch browser, then try again.
Loading models available to your ChatGPT account…
No models are available. Check that ChatGPT plan usage was granted.
Allows requested screen reading, UI actions, and answer overlays while you use the voice assistant. No key interception or passive recording.

When enabled, the assistant can send visible screen text to OpenAI during your voice requests and perform requested UI actions. Password fields are excluded, but other private screen content may be included. Screen content stays out of local logs. Enable this only if you want these tools. You can disable the service at any time in Android settings.
Signed out locally. Remote revocation was not confirmed; disconnect this app in ChatGPT settings.
This device does not provide that settings screen.

Voice only: answers appear in an overlay and use system text-to-speech. After an answer, the microphone listens for an eight-second follow-up while the voice panel is visible. Silence clears the session.

For TV button mappers, launch the VoiceActivity component or send android.intent.action.VOICE_COMMAND to this app.

ChatGPT plan access depends on your account and OpenAI availability. System speech recognition may use the device provider’s network service if on-device recognition is unavailable.
